title: Lepton List
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately list all known leptons including their antiparticles.

title: Decay Process
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly describe the decay process of muon, including the products of the decay.

title: Lepton Number Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student should define the lepton numbers for electrons and muons and explain their conservation.

title: Forbidden Reaction Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss why the reaction involving nu_mu and n is forbidden based on lepton number conservation.

title: Heavy Lepton Production
description: Important Criteria: The student should propose a reaction that produces a new charged heavy lepton while conserving lepton numbers.

title: Quantum Number Conservation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss additional conservation laws relevant to the reactions and lepton production.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect signs in lepton number assignments or decay products.

title: Missing Antiparticles
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all antiparticles are included in their lepton list.
